questions.question: Which description fits the **ValueSet** resource?
options: This resource instance specifies a set of codes drawn from one or more code systems, intended for use in a particular context.
This resource documents a set of capabilities (behaviors) of a FHIR Terminology Server that may be used as a statement of actual server functionality or a statement of required or desired server…
A statement of relationships from one set of concepts to one or more other concepts - either concepts in code systems, or data element/data element concepts, or classes in class models.
A curated namespace that issues unique symbols within that namespace for the identification of concepts, people, devices, etc.
questions.explanation: **ValueSet**: A ValueSet resource instance specifies a set of codes drawn from one or more code systems, intended for use in a particular context. Value sets link between CodeSystem definitions and their use in coded elements. The other descriptions belong to **TerminologyCapabilities**, **ConceptMap**, **NamingSystem**.

questions.question: Which resource would you use? The list of codes allowed in Patient.maritalStatus.
questions.explanation: **ValueSet**. Selects codes for a use. Elements are bound to value sets.

questions.question: You know **ValueSet**. Which resource should you use instead when you need “maps codes between systems”?
questions.explanation: **ConceptMap**: maps codes between systems. **ValueSet** is for something else: A ValueSet resource instance specifies a set of codes drawn from one or more code systems, intended for use in a particular context.

questions.question: Which element is **required** (minimum cardinality 1) in every **ValueSet** instance?
questions.explanation: The required top-level elements of ValueSet are `status` (1..1). The other options have a minimum cardinality of 0, so they are optional.

questions.question: Which element of **ValueSet** is a **modifier** (?!), so receiving systems must not ignore it?
questions.explanation: Modifier elements of ValueSet: `status`. `status`: draft | active | retired | unknown. A modifier can change the meaning of the whole resource: for example, a status of `entered-in-error` means the data must not be used.
